D1 is repeated for legibility; both symbols denote the same workspace-scoped database.
Admin maintains accounts and inspects permitted records; no financial edits or private source access.
Staff proposes; Manager authorizes and confirms rent. Utility marks are unverified.
Portal / Web Push: rent and utilities. Outgoing email: rent only.
